answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require each agent to hold a single bonded identity backed by a locked onyx stake: creating an identity costs a real deposit that is slashed if the agent cheats, so spawning thousands of fake sparrow identities multiplies the attacker's cost linearly. Honest agents build a verifiable history of completed work, and counterparties weight trust by that history, so a fresh identity starts near zero and can only reach the zenith of full trading privileges after sustained honest service. Fakes stay cheap to create but expensive to make useful.
